title: Wuro ngo e daande maayo ñaawoore
intro: Aɗa tawa hoore maa e wuro daande maayo, ɗo sawtawol ɓuuɓol jillondirta e ɓuuɓri leñol yejjittaangol. Ɓe ndokkaama yamiroore fooftere, kono njurum maɓɓe addani ɓe jukkungo ngo haa jooni ina haalee e tonngooɗe muusɗe. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade hol ɓe ngonnoo?
clues: Min nguuri ko e daande maayo, min ndokkaama yamiroore nde min mbaɗata ñalawma fooftere.
Ñalnde heen, liɗɗi ina ngara e amen haa keewi, kono min kaɗaama ƴettude ɗi.
Won e amen njeertinii e tooñannge, kono woɗɓe ina njuɓɓina liɗɗi no feewi.
En mbonnii yamiroore ceniinde nde, en ngaddii e koye men jukkungo tiiɗngo.
Jukkungo men ko waylo-waylo ngo acci en mbaylaandi e hersa.
Min mbaɗtaa ko ɓiɗɓe leɗɗe, maande wonande arooɓe caggal ɓee fof.
arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
